Description: Checks active password policies screen out common passwords.
Risk: Common passwords are heavily used in credential stuffing and password spraying attacks.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, open the general-user password policy.
2. Edit password complexity settings.
3. Enable Restrict use of common passwords.
4. Save the policy and test with a known common password in a non-production account.

Recommendation.Text: Enable common-password screening so users cannot choose passwords from known weak or commonly guessed lists.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
